floorisplan.title: FloorisPlan — Room Measurement & Estimating App
floorisplan.meta_description: FloorisPlan — measure rooms, draw floor plans and wall elevations, build work and material estimates, print contracts in DOCX, keep a job schedule. Offline Android app for contractors.
floorisplan.hero_tagline: Everything for one job in a single project card: measurements, plan, estimate, contract, and schedule.
floorisplan.workflow_title: How a job runs in FloorisPlan
floorisplan.workflow_subtitle: From the first site visit to a signed contract — without leaving the app
floorisplan.workflow_step_1_desc: Client, address, and site notes in one place. Every job is a card you come back to — nothing is lost between the notebook, the tape measure, and email.
floorisplan.workflow_step_2_desc: Dictate dimensions by voice or send them straight from a Bluetooth laser meter. The floor plan and wall elevations build themselves as you go.
floorisplan.workflow_step_3_desc: Quantities come from your measurements. Add works and materials from the catalog — or simply describe them to Floris AI and confirm the result.
floorisplan.workflow_step_4_desc: A DOCX contract with client details, scope, and total, with the estimate attached. Walk off site with a signature, not a promise.
floorisplan.audience_subtitle: FloorisPlan is built for those who measure, price, and deliver renovation work
floorisplan.audience_contractors_desc: Measure, price the job, and sign the contract in a single visit to the site.
floorisplan.audience_tilers_desc: Wall elevations show the real surface — plan the tile layout before the first cut.
floorisplan.audience_electricians_desc: Outlet, switch, and lighting layouts with exact mounting heights on every wall.
floorisplan.audience_plumbers_desc: Water and drain points with precise dimensions, snapped to the walls of the room.
floorisplan.audience_designers_desc: Measured surveys ready to hand over. Export to DXF and continue in your CAD editor.
floorisplan.audience_owners_desc: Plan the renovation and see what it costs before the work starts.
floorisplan.features_subtitle: A complete toolkit — from the first measurement to the signed document
floorisplan.feature_plans_desc: Draw rooms by voice or by tap. Area and perimeter are calculated automatically, and snapping keeps the drafting precise.
floorisplan.feature_voice_desc: Say "line 500 right", "width 900" — no typing while your hands are busy with the tape measure.
floorisplan.feature_laser_desc: Pair a supported laser distance meter, press its button, and the measurement lands straight in the plan.
floorisplan.feature_walls_desc: Unfold any wall and see its full surface, with every outlet, switch, and water point in its exact position.
floorisplan.feature_points_desc: Outlets, switches, ceiling and wall lights, water and drain points, installations with mounting dimensions.
floorisplan.feature_estimate_desc: Works and materials priced straight from the plan. Your own catalog, category totals, PDF export, 52 currencies.
floorisplan.feature_ai_desc: Say or type what needs to change: AI fills in the estimate, adds a client, a payment, a task, or a date in the calendar. 10 requests free, 200 requests per month with Pro.
floorisplan.feature_schedule_desc: Reserve the dates each job takes, with the client and booking status attached. Overlapping jobs are visible before you promise a start date.
floorisplan.feature_profile_desc: A business card for clients: photos of completed work and contact links — WhatsApp, social media, website. Up to 8 work examples.
floorisplan.feature_contracts_desc: Built from the project data. Use the standard template or import your own with placeholders — the estimate is inserted automatically.
floorisplan.feature_export_desc: DXF opens in any desktop CAD editor, PDF is ready for printing and for the client. Export is free, with no limits.
floorisplan.screenshot_alt_1: Project card with client, work dates, estimate and contract on one screen
floorisplan.screenshot_alt_2: Floor plan with automatic area and dimension calculations
floorisplan.screenshot_alt_3: Wall elevations with outlets, switches and openings
floorisplan.screenshot_alt_4: Work estimate with quantities and prices calculated from the measurements
floorisplan.screenshot_alt_5: Job schedule with booked work dates
floorisplan.screenshot_alt_6: DOCX contract with client details, scope of work and total
floorisplan.pricing_lead: Every feature is free at this stage
floorisplan.pricing_desc: Measurements and floor plans, wall elevations, electrical and plumbing, estimates, DOCX contracts, DXF and PDF export, schedule and professional profile — free, with no limits.
floorisplan.pricing_paid_desc: The first 10 assistant requests are free. After that, Pro covers 200 requests per month. Everything else stays free, and supporting development is entirely voluntary.
floorisplan.cta_subtitle: Download FloorisPlan and run your next job from the first measurement to a signed contract.
